Hi all — attaching the pricing workbook and a short note on trade-offs. Summary:

- 12-month baseline: keeps current pricing, modest discount for annual commit.
- 24-month baseline: additional 8–12% discount depending on committed GPU-hours; recommend 15% discount if they increase committed capacity by >=20% across the contracted baseline.
- Quantization uplift: adopting 8-bit quantization reduces per-token cost by ~22% on our tests for their model family, but we price the white-glove quantization support as a one-time engineering fee + a small monthly support add-on (line item in workbook).

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Options_2026.xlsx (pricing tiers + math)

Action items I recommend we include in the QBR deck:
- Projected spend under 12mo vs 24mo with usage scenarios (conservative, expected, high)
- Upfront engineering support scope for quantization + timeline (2–4 weeks)
- Proposed SLA/commit changes for reserved burst pools

I’ll be available for the Tue Oct 20 10:00–11:00 PT slot.

Rishi Malhotra
